input.query: Who painted the fictional mural Harbor of Seven Bells?

evidence.text: The fictional Seven Bells Square is paved with gray cobblestones.
The fictional mural Harbor of Seven Bells was painted by Ilsa Marrow alone. Kerran Pell only built the wooden frame around it.
Fictional harbor murals are often repainted after storms.
The fictional Pell workshop makes picture frames and cabinets.

A fictional bell foundry once stood at the end of the pier.
